pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (order of evaluation and exponentiation exceptions, which apply 'regardless of the mode of arithmetic'), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 ('with a precision of 32 decimal digits') and §2002:8.8.1.3.2 (each sum 'truncated to 32 significant digits'), and §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation); this text governs only under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD (§2002:8.8.1.3), and the compiler keeps 34 digits there at --std 2002 (PB5575, reconfirmed by probes-a-21/src/vals.cob: (B*100 + 1) - B*100 gives 1 where 2002 gives 0). Read §2002:14.5.12.1.2 and §2002:14.5.12.1.3 (fatal and non-fatal processing; 2023's version adds SORT/MERGE, fatal EC-I-O, PERFORM ... WHEN and APPLY COMMIT steps, none of which exists in 2002 or applies here) and §2002:14.5.12.2 (incompatible data: numeric/boolean sending operands and de-editing MOVE). GR18 evaluates no arithmetic. It says the screen DISPLAY is unsuccessful when one of four EC-SCREEN conditions exists (§2002:14.8.10.3 GR18); fatal or non-fatal processing would follow, but the screen format is processor-dependent in 2002 and the compiler declines every DISPLAY screen statement at --std 2002 with a diagnostic, so nothing runs. Incompatible data does not arise.
